label: Self-origination assessed through the existing existential-production proof
summary: Warrant and derivation assessment of the bare STMT-NOTHING-ORIGINATES-ITSELF, without premise discharge. DEF-CAUSE-OF-ORIGIN paraphrases an originating cause as 'other than the thing itself', but its primitive CausesOrigin field does not enforce distinctness and the conclusion is not obtained by that definition. The previously verified noSelf result from four OPEN mixed-token priority conditions excludes an act producing its own bearer's existence: an occurring exercise presupposes its bearer's existence, production of existence is explanatorily prior to its product, and one transitive irreflexive order forbids the resulting two-step cycle. No temporal precedence is needed. New explicit bridge OriginHasProductiveExercise says that each CausesOrigin c x edge has an occurring exercise a borne by c that produces x's existence. New argument noSelfOriginFromNoSelfProduction derives the bare target from this OPEN bridge plus the existing NoSelfProduction statement; the latter retains its four-premise certified support route. The Solution also contains a direct Lean composition invoking the prior noSelf theorem. The challenge, corpus argument/result and comparator configuration are registered; their formal verification passed CI on fe55756c. Ordinary self-repair, feedback after existence and an intrinsic nonproductive explanation do not instantiate production of one's own existence. The strongest distinct rival proposes simultaneous/non-well-founded origination for which bearer-to-act or act-to-product priority fails. The existing unique-feedback Boolean control shows consistency of a feedback constraint, not an actual existential-origin mechanism or independent warrant for that denial. Provisional judgment: the prohibition is strongly supported for genuinely productive origin under the five explicit open premises, while the universal primitive statement stays unestablished. Independent semantic challenge found no P1 in the staged bridge/proof/records and identified this bookkeeping update as P2. No new source attribution or rival refutation is claimed. Follow-up warrant reassessment (2026-11-12, docs/notes/unique-feedback-explanation-311.md): Aristotle Physics II.3's builder/building distinction supplies positive conceptual warrant for an occurring exercise when an originating cause is an ACTUAL positive efficient producer, but no deductive universal passage from observed production to primitive CausesOrigin. Hall's dependence/production distinction supports a substantive wider causal reading in which omissions are causes without positive productive activities; its applicability to CAUSE_4 rather than generic event-causation is contested. Aquinas ST I q.45 a.3 distinguishes creation from motion and identifies divine active creation with divine essence, so Occurs must not be misread as a temporal accident or a real distinct act; bearer-to-act priority remains OPEN. Gott and Li (1998) solve self-consistent CTC spacetime/field configurations and separately propose a conditional baby-universe reidentification (later baby universe is the earlier universe); it is not a solved dynamical self-generation model. This is a more concrete research target than the Boolean feedback control, but realizing that reidentification and transferring phase edges to CausesOrigin(whole,whole), and thence to a bearer activity producing the whole's total existence, are independently OPEN; no empirical actuality is claimed. Provisional judgment refined: bridge favored for positive efficient origination, not warranted for all dependence-based causes; no self-origin premise established. Primary text links and precise discriminating tests are preserved in the existing note. Formal CI run 43245028464 and completed Codex review on fe55756c passed with no major findings; the added warrant research is prose only. Further analysis (2026-11-12; same linked note): Anthony E. Newman (2026, sections 3-5) gives a positive causal-loop composition argument and explicitly endorses as plausible Quentin Smith's universe at t=0: constituents a,b,c simultaneously cause one another to BEGIN EXISTING, and Smith infers self-causation of the universe as a whole. Newman distinguishes this finite mutually causal beginning from a beginningless internal chain and notes the thesis can be restated for THINGS as causal relata. The Smith case is a genuine hypothetical existential-origin challenge, not merely event recurrence and not evidence of an actual self-creating cosmos. The exact adjudication requires whether reciprocal constituent origination productively causes the numerically same whole to BEGIN existing (and in a 4D reading its entire history), whether the whole bears an actual productive exercise rather than only its parts, and whether one strict existential/act priority relation applies to the simultaneous case; none can be rejected by stipulation. Gott-Li's physical baby-universe self-identification remains conditional. A positive actual-source warrant is identified for the bearer-to-exercise direction: genuinely productive origination needs an actual bearer of the power when exercised, even if contemporaneous; the hard Smith test is whether simultaneous mutual first-existence production can furnish such powers without presupposing its producers. This is not a proved rejection of simultaneous reciprocal actualization, and strict act-to-product explanatory priority remains a separate live burden. A strictly weaker structural proof condition suffices: asymmetry of the supplied mixed priority forbids the two-token bearer/exercise reciprocal pair directly, without global transitivity. The old irreflexive+transitive bundle implies asymmetry; the converse fails on a directed three-cycle. This analytic strengthening is NOT registered or certified as a new result: the normal spec batch attempt was stopped by the legacy DISAMB-MIXED-EXISTENTIAL-PRIORITY index, which classifies BearerPrior and ProductPrior structural properties of the SAME relation as separate senses and would require a misleading sense bridge. The invalid generated batch was deleted. Root support remains the previously verified two-layer route; no newly closed premise, theorem or proposition is claimed. Reopen normal registration once the sense taxonomy permits multiple properties of one relation. Repair after independent semantic challenge (2026-11-14): (1) the shared parameter produces is now fixed in both premise records to the sense of DEF-NO-EXISTENTIAL-SELF-PRODUCTION, production of the resultant individual's being; the step from CAUSE_4 coming-to-be to producing being is named as OPEN bridge content, and the builder example is kept only as an illustration of the actual-exercise requirement, not as an instance (a builder is a cause of becoming, not of being, ST I q.104 a.1). (2) The asymmetry route is now Lean-checked by unregistered theorems in the OriginExerciseBridge Solution (noSelfProductionOfAsymmetric, noSelfOriginFromAsymmetric, asymmetricOfIrreflexiveTransitive and the three-cycle strictness witness); still no corpus result or Comparator certificate. (3) The actual-source principle warrants co-actuality only; strict BearerPrior needs the further clause that the bearer's existence is not supplied by the same exercise or loop, and that clause is OPEN against simultaneous reciprocal actualization. (4) The universal form of the bridge is kept as the productive reading of CAUSE_4. Superseded by #1610 (2026-11-14): the self-edge sibling OriginHasProductiveSelfExercise (DEF 62acf1f0) is now registered with its own statement, the universal bridge strengthens it (verified instantiation result selfExerciseOfExercise), and a new sibling argument (theorem noSelfOriginFromSelfExercise, new Challenge OriginExerciseBridge.SelfEdge, result 9598a73d) derives the same conclusion from the sibling and NoSelfProduction. Argument e9a9eeaf, its frozen Challenge and result 3630bbec are unchanged and remain a support alternative (invariant 12; an initial re-point of e9a9eeaf was withdrawn after the independent semantic challenge on #1627). The difference is certified (#1598 strength_comparison): universalOverSelfExact proves universal iff self-edge sibling and NonSelfOriginHasProductiveExercise (every origin edge is a self-edge or productively exercised by its source) with zero axioms and without decidable identity, and the other-only frame (true originates false, no exercises) separates them. Warrant difference: every defeater of the sibling defeats the universal form, not conversely; the builder (cause of becoming, not of being) and Hall-style omission and prevention cases have distinct relata and bear only on the delta; the broad dependence reading of CAUSE_4 bears on the sibling only through a self-edge such as the Smith whole. The sibling keeps the self-edge coming-to-be-to-being step, where the Smith/Newman whole-borne-exercise dispute sits, so the live objection is untouched and both bridges remain OPEN. DISAMB-MIXED-EXISTENTIAL-PRIORITY's resolution was corrected now that its mixed-domain uses lie on a root route.
blocker: Assess Newman's expressly existential Smith case: a universe of three mutually beginning-to-exist constituents at t=0, which Smith and Newman contend is self-caused. Determine whether the constituents' production licenses originating causation of the same composite whole, whether that whole bears the relevant productive exercise (rather than merely containing the exercises of its parts), and whether the bearer-to-act and act-to-product strict priority claims hold in simultaneous origination. Separately trace any phase-event CTC to total 4D bearer-origination without equivocation. Defend applicability of the origin-to-exercise interpretation, bearer/product mixed priority and at least its local two-way asymmetry against a fully specified CTC or simultaneous case. Gott-Li's proposed baby-universe identification is not a solved self-generation result. Defend or reject the coming-to-be-to-being step of the bridge for ordinary origination, and the extra non-self-supply clause of strict BearerPrior against simultaneous reciprocal actualization. The strict weaker asymmetry route is Lean-checked (unregistered) and should be registered as a corpus result after the preexisting DISAMB-MIXED-EXISTENTIAL-PRIORITY taxonomy stops treating two structural properties of one Prior as distinct senses; do not fabricate an equivocation premise. Formal root premise remains OPEN and no actual-world self-origination has been demonstrated.
